title: Feature: Return helpers in hits > empty template
body:
The use case is to display certain text only if there was a `query` given for a search, otherwise display a different message. Outside of using a closure there's no helpful methods.

For example. the `Toggle` widget has a `isRefined` parameter that is passed to the template so you can use it like so:

```js
{{#isRefined}}checked{{/isRefined}}
```

It would be great to have a few like this for the hit>empty template to use like so..

```js
No recipes were found with that criteria {{#hasQuery}}matching the search term{{query}}{{/hasQuery}}
```
